programme.title: ABC News Breakfast
programme.desc: James Glenday and Emma Rebellato bring you the latest news, overnight developments, interviews and new details on the top stories this morning, joined by Catherine Murphy with sport and Nate Byrne with your weather outlook.

programme.title: ABC News Mornings
programme.desc: Stay in the know with what's happening this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Gemma Veness.

programme.title: Four Corners
programme.desc: Escaping Kabul tells the dramatic story of the secret international mission to rescue Afghanistan's female cyclists after the Taliban's return to power placed them in grave danger.

programme.title: Restoration Australia
programme.desc: Host Anthony Burke meets a First Nations family aiming to reinterpret a simple and remote timber church into a getaway home honouring dispossessed ancestors and proud culture.

programme.title: ABC News At Noon
programme.desc: The leading news at lunchtime. Ros Childs brings you the day's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.

programme.title: National Press Club
programme.sub-title: Senator Pauline Hanson - Leader of One Nation
programme.desc: Senator Pauline Hanson, Leader of One Nation, addresses the National Press Club of Australia for the "Leaders Address to the National Press Club".

programme.title: Media Watch
programme.desc: The interventions of Elon Musk in the Belfast riots show, again, how he uses his platform X to amplify hate. Plus a preference-flow graph in the Australian Financial Review includes political parties you've never heard of.

programme.title: Spicks and Specks
programme.desc: It's story time on Spicks with Justine Clarke. There's a bear in there and people as well, with Alan, Myf and Adam joined by Miss Kaninna, Tommy Little, Don West, Geraldine Hickey and a stunning performance by Montaigne.

programme.title: Anh's Brush With Fame
programme.desc: Kate Ritchie grew up in front of the nation. She was cast as Sally on Home and Away and played the role for two decades, with her own experiences reflected in her character. Anh must capture her warmth and authenticity.

programme.title: Restoration Australia
programme.desc: When Mel and Jack buy a derelict old Queenslander for $21,000 and move it to their land in Noosa it seems they've scored the bargain of the century, or at least a century old bargain!

programme.title: Murdoch Mysteries
programme.desc: After saving his lover Anna from the Black Hand, Detective Murdoch bargains for her life. During his investigation into the murder of a shy librarian with a secret life, he encounters another young woman behaving seductively.

programme.title: Long Lost Family
programme.desc: We meet Christine Gillard who for almost 50 years has lived with the pain of having given up her first born daughter, not once but twice. And Robert Lindsay, searching for the Croatian dad he has never met.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce and the experts pay a visit to the grounds of the Yorkshire Museum in York. Family treasures brought before the cameras include a spy camera disguised as a silver box.

programme.title: Hard Quiz
programme.desc: Tom Gleeson faces an onslaught from experts in Shakespeare's Macbeth, animated sitcom Family Guy, Canadian rock band Rush and disaster movie Armageddon. Who will win the Big Brass Mug?

programme.title: ABC News Hour
programme.desc: News from where we live. ABC News Victoria brings you the day's top stories, exclusive investigations and original reporting on the issues that matter to you. Presented by Tamara Oudyn (Sun-Thu) and Iskhandar Razak (Fri-Sat).

Sarah Ferguson presents Australia's premier daily current affairs program, delivering agenda-setting public affairs journalism and interviews that hold the powerful to account. Plus political analysis from Jacob Greber.

programme.title: Gruen
programme.desc: Looking for a love match? Swipe right on Gruen. We'll treat you right. Wil Anderson, Todd Sampson and Russel Howcroft are joined by Karen Ferry and Liana Rossi.

programme.title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont-Spelling Bee
programme.sub-title: I Knew This Day Would Come
programme.desc: The reigning champ goes against John Safran, Tilly Oddy-Black and Will Gibb. Expect time travel, comedians fearlessly shoving their hands into mystery boxes, and Sam Campbell somehow evolving into a full-blown hacking genius.

programme.title: Race Around The World
programme.desc: In episode two, six filmmakers battle harsh critiques, technical disasters and cultural challenges as they create short films across the globe, with one standout rising to the top.

programme.title: Planet America
programme.sub-title: Iran ceasefire deal on Trump's 80th Birthday
programme.desc: Trump claims victory after a long-awaited peace deal is agreed with Iran. As Congress advances a US-Israel military integration plan, we ask former national security official Josh Paul why the measure has sparked a backlash.

programme.title: ABC Late News

programme.title: ARIA Hall of Fame 2026
programme.desc: To celebrate the 40th anniversary of the ARIA Hall of Fame, ARIA are inducting six incredible Australian artists: Gurrumul, Jenny Morris, Kate Ceberano, Spiderbait, The Living End and Vika and Linda. Hosted by Myf Warhurst.

programme.desc: Poh moves out of her kitchen and heads off overseas - to Malaysia, the country where she was born. She is on a three-week trip starting in Kuala Lumpur to find out more about her heritage and traditional Malaysian dishes.

programme.title: Thomas and Friends: All Engines Go!

programme.title: Play School: Down At The Beach

programme.title: Fireman Sam

programme.title: Miffy and Friends

programme.title: The Woohoos!

programme.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood

programme.title: Mittens and Pants

programme.title: BeddyByes

programme.title: Mixmups

programme.title: Ready Eddie Go!

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: George is making bubbles and Peppa is popping them. When the bubble mixture runs out, Daddy Pig shows them how to make really big bubbles then makes a big, muddy, bubbly puddle for everyone to play in.

programme.title: Maddie and Triggs

programme.title: Maddie and Triggs
